name: T900 Ultra Smart Watch
description:
RAM: 196KB
ROM: 1MB+64MB
Charge Mode: Wireless
Display Resolution: 280 x 320p
Standby Time: 65 days
Usage Time: About 10 days
High fidelity sound quality waterproof horn
New Upgrade chip
Shows notification of
Calls / Email / SMS / WhatsApp / WeChat & etc
Color: Black, Orange
This T900 Ultra smartwatch comes with a 1.99" IPS screen that supports 280 x 320 pixels resolution. It is a watch that offers many smart features including call, email, SMS, WhatsApp, and WeChat notifications of smartphones that connect to it and show on the watch. In addition, this watch has 196KB RAM and 1MB + 64MB ROM capacity. Also, it can charge wirelessly. Moreover, it comes with a 380mAh lithium-ion polymer battery.
